description:
Model switch-mode power supply control loops using small-signal transfer functions.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Cross-parameter checks: converter_duty_in_ccm_range, converter_load_nonzero, feedback_reference_within_output, crossover_solve_supported. Time budget 300 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"topology":"buck","controlMode":"voltage_mode","Vin":12,"Vout":5,"Iout":2,"L":0.000047}
Returns: The crossover frequency, phase and gain margins and a pass, fail or slow verdict against the minimums, the loop’s poles and zeros, any standard-value R_c, C_c and C_hf the solve placed, Monte Carlo margin statistics with the share of trials without a margin, and the loop gain, phase and plant responses as series. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

C.description: Output Capacitance (F). e.g. 220e-6 for 220 µF. min 1e-12. omit for the default of 0.00022

ESR.description: Capacitor ESR (Ω). Equivalent series resistance of output capacitor. min 0. omit for the default of 0.05

Fsw.description: Switching Frequency (Hz). min 1000, max 10000000. omit for the default of 100000

Iout.description: Output Current (A). min 0.1, max 100. omit for the default of 2

L.description: Inductance (H). e.g. 47e-6 for 47 µH. min 1e-9. omit for the default of 0.000047

Rsense.description: Sense Resistor (Ω). min 0.001. omit for the default of 0.1. Applies when controlMode is "peak_current".

Vin.description: Input Voltage (V). min 1, max 1000. omit for the default of 12

Vout.description: Output Voltage (V). min 0.5, max 999. omit for the default of 5

Vramp.description: Sawtooth Amplitude (V). Peak-to-peak sawtooth amplitude for the PWM comparator. min 0.1. omit for the default of 1. Applies when controlMode is "voltage_mode".

capacitorSeries.description: Capacitor Series. omit for the default of "E12". Applies when solveFor is "crossover".

compCc.description: Compensation Capacitor (C_c) (F). e.g. 8.2e-9 for 8.2 nF. min 1e-12, max 0.001. omit for the default of 8.2e-9. Applies when compensatorType is "type2_ota".

compChf.description: High-Frequency Capacitor (C_hf) (F). Sets the high-frequency pole, (C_c + C_hf)/(2π·R_c·C_c·C_hf). 0 leaves it out. min 0, max 0.000001. omit for the default of 1.1e-10. Applies when compensatorType is "type2_ota".

compFp1.description: Pole 1 Frequency (Hz). min 1. omit for the default of 20000. Applies when compensatorType is "type1", "type2" or "type3".

compFp2.description: Pole 2 Frequency (Hz). min 1. omit for the default of 50000. Applies when compensatorType is "type3".

compFz1.description: Zero 1 Frequency (Hz). min 1. omit for the default of 500. Applies when compensatorType is "type1", "type2" or "type3".

compFz2.description: Zero 2 Frequency (Hz). min 1. omit for the default of 1500. Applies when compensatorType is "type3".

compGm.description: Amplifier Transconductance (g_m) (S). e.g. 1e-3 for 1 mS. min 0.000001, max 0.1. omit for the default of 0.001. Applies when compensatorType is "type2_ota".

compK.description: Compensator Gain (K) (rad/s). min 0.001. omit for the default of 2000. Applies when compensatorType is "type1", "type2" or "type3".

compRc.description: Compensation Resistor (R_c) (Ω). R_c with C_c sets the compensator zero, 1/(2π·R_c·C_c), and with g_m and the divider the mid-band gain. min 1, max 10000000. omit for the default of 5760. Applies when compensatorType is "type2_ota".

compVref.description: Feedback Reference (V_ref) (V). The error amplifier’s reference. The feedback divider is V_ref/V_out, so V_ref may not exceed V_out. min 0.1, max 999. omit for the default of 0.8. Applies when compensatorType is "type2_ota".

compensatorType.description: Compensator. omit for the default of "type3"

controlMode.description: Control Mode. omit for the default of "voltage_mode"

externalRamp.description: External Ramp (Se/Sn). Slope compensation as a fraction of the sensed inductor up-slope; 0 applies none. Above 50 % duty cycle the inductor-current loop needs m_c·D′ > 0.5, where m_c = 1 + Se/Sn. min 0, max 10. omit for the default of 0. Applies when controlMode is "peak_current".

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

minGainMargin.description: Minimum Gain Margin (dB). The verdict, the Monte Carlo yield and the crossover solve all require at least this gain margin. min 0, max 40. omit for the default of 10

minPhaseMargin.description: Minimum Phase Margin (°). The verdict, the Monte Carlo yield and the crossover solve all require at least this phase margin. min 0, max 90. omit for the default of 45

monteCarloTrials.description: MC Trials. Each trial re-evaluates T(s) with randomized component values. min 1000, max 500000. omit for the default of 200000

resistorSeries.description: Resistor Series. omit for the default of "E96". Applies when solveFor is "crossover".

solveFor.description: Solve For. Crossover places R_c, C_c and C_hf for the target crossover in peak-current mode: the zero at the load pole, the high-frequency pole at the lower of Fsw/2 and the ESR zero, each part snapped to its standard series. omit for the default of "none". Applies when compensatorType is "type2_ota".

targetCrossover.description: Target Crossover (Hz). Must be below Fsw/2. When left blank, a tenth of the switching frequency. min 1, max 5000000. Omit to let the service derive it: Fsw / 10. Applies when solveFor is "crossover".

tolC.description: Capacitor Tolerance (%). min 0, max 100. omit for the default of 20

tolESR.description: ESR Tolerance (%). min 0, max 200. omit for the default of 50

tolL.description: Inductor Tolerance (%). min 0, max 100. omit for the default of 20

tolLoad.description: Load Tolerance (%). min 0, max 100. omit for the default of 30

tolRsense.description: Sense Resistor Tolerance (%). min 0, max 100. omit for the default of 1. Applies when controlMode is "peak_current". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

toleranceDistribution.description: Distribution. omit for the default of "gaussian"

topology.description: Topology. omit for the default of "buck"

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).
